description: Fixed attended Episode 2 marketing-video workflow with canonical native evidence and project-local wiki retrieval.
cleanup_policy: The durable SDTK ledger is retained. No task may delete or overwrite evidence from a prior stage.
evidence_expectations: All customer-pain claims are supported by public evidence or a real product capture.
Product proof uses real sdtk usage output and identifies the capture path and SHA-256.
Video-quality evidence is factual; failed gates block picture lock.
Social payload preparation is checked but never uploads or publishes content.
No credential, token, Telegram identifier, or raw secret appears in task evidence.
